utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I brought some extra wrenches; hope they help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I'll add them to the pile. Rosa has a list if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, just let me know if you need me to fetch anything from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm almost done tallying the supplies, just need a few more minutes for that list Rosa wanted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually making that list? I thought Rosa was just joking about needing all that stuff.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No, she was serious. We really do need those supplies to fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I heard you're joining the repair drive too. I've been helping Uli organize the tools over at Opal's garage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's great, Sam! Just to make sure, the repair drive is actually this Sunday at the community center, not Opal's garage.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for letting me know! I'll let Uli know we need to move the tools to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can take care of any squeaky doors or basic furniture fixes. Gus is bringing his tools, so we'll be all set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, we're all meeting at the community center on 5th Street this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that's correct. 5th Street community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Don't forget, Gus has wrenches and screwdrivers if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll note that. The drive is at the community center on 5th Street, so Gus can bring his tools there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll tell Gus to bring his tools to the community center. What time does the drive start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'll bring my stuff by later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, see you then. Don't forget it's Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday at the community center. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Ira, did I miss anything about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just that it's this Saturday at the community center — Rey's getting tools together, and Cleo's tracking parts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Okay, great. What time does it start? I want to make sure I'm not late.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, is the repair drive still set for this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it's still on Saturday at the community center. And Cleo's keeping track of the parts inventory.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Should we assign Eli to the squeaky doors since he knows carpentry?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, have we thought about how we're going to get the tools over to the repair site without a car?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Maybe we can ask around the neighborhood—I bet someone with a truck would be willing to help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good idea, but we need to make sure whoever helps is free this weekend—otherwise we might end up waiting too long.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Mina's repair drive is coming up. I'm thinking of helping with small electronics or sewing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center! I'm helping out too—maybe we can work together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll be there! What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Eli will be there and Gus has the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll make sure to be there with snacks for everyone. What time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we're kicking off around 9 AM. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. So you've got the wrenches and screwdrivers ready? Great, I think I saw that power drill somewhere in my garage too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A power drill could come in handy. Want me to take a look at it and make sure it's working?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, if you want, but it might be buried under some stuff. I'll try to dig it out later.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I've got it all set for Sunday at the community center! We're looking forward to a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, I thought it was Saturday at 10? Did the date change?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'm sorry for the confusion, Dane. It's actually this Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I've got a few things to drop off for the repair drive. Where should I bring them?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring them to the community center on 5th Street, Saturday 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I'll swing by Saturday with my items.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I've got some wrenches and screwdrivers ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I can help with small electronics and sewing. Do you need any other tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I think we might need some pliers or wire cutters for the electronics. Got any?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: So the repair drive's all set for Saturday at the community center, right? I heard Rey's already gathering tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Actually, I thought Gus was bringing the tools. I'll handle the door and furniture repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think Rey's definitely got the tools covered. Good to know you'll be on door and furniture repairs though!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'm sure. The school calendar is clear that weekend, and many parents have signed up to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But how do we know it'll actually work? I've seen flyers for neighborhood cleanups before that fell through.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Pia, do you know if we have enough screws for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure, Cleo. I haven't checked the supply box recently. We might need to count them beforehand to avoid running out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good idea, I'll start counting what we have now and make a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I brought some of my tools over to the community center. Let me know where you need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Uli! Let's put them in Opal's garage, that's where we're organizing everything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal's garage? I thought it was at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive? We're getting everyone together to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've been keeping track — it's this Saturday, 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on 5th Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, you're in the loop! Are you planning to come by and lend a hand? We could use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help with the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely! I'll be there to help, and I'm also planning to put up some flyers at the coffee shop and library to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, glad you can come. Any chance you know someone who could help with electrical work?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, and don't forget that Gus is happy to lend his wrenches and screwdrivers for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, Gus is always so generous with his tools. I'll be there too, ready to fix things up!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Tess! I'm glad you can make it. Let's make this repair drive a success.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know Eli's coming and Gus has the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Gus has a power drill? I thought it was just wrenches and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: He told me he'd bring everything we need, so I assume the drill is covered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, just to confirm, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center on 5th Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that's right! Saturday at the community center. And Cleo's handling the parts inventory—she's got it all organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Oren. So I just need to bring my tools, right? Or is there a list of what I should contribute?
